AI transcription FAQs
How much does AI transcription cost?
AI transcription typically costs between $0.10 to $0.25 per minute of audio, significantly cheaper than human transcription services, which can range from $1 to $3 per minute, offering a cost-effective and efficient alternative. Learn more about
Notta’s pricing
.
What is automatic speech recognition?
Automatic speech recognition
(ASR) is a technology that converts spoken language into text, enabling hands-free control and accurate transcription of audio content.
Can I translate transcripts and subtitles to other languages?
Yes, you can translate transcripts and subtitles into 41 different languages using Notta. This feature ensures your content is accessible to a global audience. Here’s how to translate text in Notta:
1.
Log into Notta and select the transcript that you want to translate.
2.
Click the
‘
Translate
’
button above the transcript area, then select the translation language. The translated text will be generated in seconds.
3.
Review the translated content and download the file in your desired format.
What is the best way to transcribe audio with accents, background noise, or poor quality?
The best way to transcribe audio with accents, background noise, or poor quality is to use advanced AI transcription tools like Notta, which are designed to handle diverse audio inputs. Accuracy can significantly decrease with poor audio quality, so it’s crucial to use noise reduction features, enhance audio clarity before transcription, and manually review and edit the transcriptions to ensure precision.
Can I upload large files into Notta?
Yes, you can upload large files into Notta. The platform supports audio files up to 1GB and video files up to 10GB in various formats, including WAV, MP3, M4A, and MP4. Additionally, users can import media files directly from YouTube, Google Drive, and Dropbox for transcription.
